title: 楼梯上的小弟弟  (The Boy on the Stairs)

segments.t: Stepping out into the sunlit courtyard, Teacher Song tells Qing more about the two boys from Wutong Lane, unaware that Hao has walked down the outdoor stairs behind them. Listen first.
宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
那抱着木头小火车的弟弟呢？
安静极了！他坐在第三级台阶上，听每一个音符。
听房间里的声音……等一下！
每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
对，小晴。那个蓝行李箱是我的——我把实情全告诉你们。
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
'Teacher Song, tell me more about those two brothers on Wutong Lane!' Pairing 'older brother' and 'younger brother' creates
兄弟
the collective word for brothers.
哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
'The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.' Frequency word
总是
means 'always', capturing how the older boy hurried through every lesson.
安静极了！他坐在第三级台阶上，听每一个音符。
'So quiet! He sat on the third step, listening to every single note.' Each stair steps and school grades share the counter
级
giving 'the third stair step'.
每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
'Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.' Making a comparison without naming 'than' uses
更
right before 'warm' to mean 'even warmer'.
因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
'Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...' Acoustic gem:
回声
literally 'returning sound', names an echo in two transparent characters.
天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
'Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!' Eyes come in pairs, so Mandarin counts 'this pair of eyes' with the exact same pair-word used for shoes!
宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
'Teacher Song?! The Teacher Song who taught my brother piano every Friday?!' Short everyday compound
弹琴
means 'play the piano' or any stringed or keyboard instrument.
对，小晴。那个蓝行李箱是我的——我把实情全告诉你们。
'Yes, Qing. That blue suitcase is mine—and I will tell you both the whole truth.' Built from 'true' and 'situation',
实情
means 'the real story' or 'the whole truth'. Now let's hear the whole conversation again from start to finish.
宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
那抱着木头小火车的弟弟呢？
安静极了！他坐在第三级台阶上，听每一个音符。
听房间里的声音……等一下！
每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
宋老师？！每星期五教我哥哥弹琴的宋老师？！
等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
对，小晴。那个蓝行李箱是我的——我把实情全告诉你们。
Little Zhihao from the third stair is standing right in front of his childhood piano teacher—and he owns the mystery blue suitcase. Episode 4 is complete; see you in Episode 5.
下次见！
